lae_centaur9_1.m: I am Thalos. Human, you are not welcome here.
r: I am just looking for my brother, Andor. Have you perhaps seen him?
I mean no harm. I come in peace, seeking to understand your ways.
May I try riding one of your centaurs?

lae_centaur9_10.m: If you truly wish to prove yourself, you must complete a task for us.
r: What task do you require of me?
I won't clean out your stable.
I met acquaintances in the entrance to the cave.
I have found my brother Andor, locked in a room down in that cave.
The creature has been slain. Your island is safe once more.

lae_centaur9_110.m: Even more people. Terrible - does it never end?
r: I'll continue looking for the monster

lae_centaur9_12.m: There is a foul creature that lurks in the cave to the west. It resembles a human but is far more savage.

lae_centaur9_12a.m: It attacks my people and threatens our way of life.

r: It is deadly? Then I'll make sure it's dead.
Yes. I'll go free him now.

lae_centaur9_132.m: Do that if you must. Although I am not glad with even more humans on our island.

lae_centaur9_134.m: After all, humans are a useless nuisance to centaur society.

lae_centaur9_1a.m: What business do you have on our island?
r: I am just looking for my brother, Andor. Have you perhaps seen him?
I mean no harm. I come in peace, seeking to understand your ways.
May I try riding one of your centaurs?

lae_centaur9_1b.m: Understand our ways? Humans have never cared to understand us. They see us as nothing more than beasts of burden.
r: I'm not like other humans. I respect your kind and wish to prove it.

lae_centaur9_2.m: This Andor, does he look a bit like you?
r: Yes, yes. Have you seen him? Where is he? When?
Never, ever try to elicit a straight answer from a centaur.

lae_centaur9_30.m: Go and slay this beast. Then I will reconsider your intentions.

lae_centaur9_300.m: Impressive, human. Yes, I can feel it.
r: And this heart does prove it.
I wanted to prove it with the monster's heart, but I seem to have lost it. Just a minute ...

lae_centaur9_302.m: That foul creature is no more. A great burden is lifted from my heart.

lae_centaur9_310.m: You have proven yourself to be more than just another ignorant human.

lae_centaur9_32.m: We centaurs have difficulty walking up stairs and fighting monsters in caves.

lae_centaur9_34.m: Here you humans are exceptionally advantageous.

lae_centaur9_35.m: Go and free us from the bane of all centaurs.
r: Consider it done. I will rid your island of this threat.

lae_centaur9_36.m: Do not underestimate the danger, human. This creature is formidable.

lae_centaur9_38.m: But if you succeed, your efforts will be rewarded.

lae_centaur9_390.m: Alas, you have earned our gratitude.

lae_centaur9_392.m: You are free to roam our island as you please. And know that you will always have a friend in the centaurs.

lae_centaur9_8.m: Words are cheap. Actions speak louder.

lae_centaurs.10: The island west of Remgard was inhabited by centaurs who were very angry about your visit. They told me to seek out their leader, Thalos. He should be in the northeast of the island.
lae_centaurs.30: He ordered me to slay a foul creature that hides in a cave on the hills of Laeroth Island, because the centaurs can't enter it.
lae_centaurs.110: In the cave entrance I have met Algangror, who asked for help.
lae_centaurs.112: In a cave entrance I have met Jhaeld of Remgard, who asked for help.
lae_centaurs.120: A common friend would be trapped deeper in the cave and I should free him.
lae_centaurs.130: Down in the cave I have found my brother Andor, locked in a room with no doors or other entrances.
lae_centaurs.140:
To open an entrance I had to find the four scrolls of elements and the three color globes. These were hidden all over the island.
The scrolls and globes would need to be properly placed around Andor's golden prison.
lae_centaurs.150: The wall opened and gave access to the interior of the room.
lae_centaurs.160: With an intense sound, the wall built up again. I've been locked up!
lae_centaurs.170: The only way out was down a staircase, which, however, seemed to be magically secured.
lae_centaurs.180: The only way out was down a staircase, which, however, seemed to be magically secured.
lae_centaurs.190: It was no problem going downstairs, but something was wrong there.
lae_centaurs.200: The whole thing was just a big scam to lure me into this cave to serve Dorhantarh as dinner.
lae_centaurs.210: The moment I placed the Scroll of Fire on the table, it exploded. At the same time the wall opened again.
lae_centaurs.300: I brought the monster's heart to Thalos and told him that the danger has been averted. He was impressed and relieved at the same time.
lae_centaurs.310: Since then I have been a welcome guest of the centaurs.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
